benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 2 years or less by an additional year.
benefits.terms: Purchase must be made with the card. Confirm current per-claim/per-account caps with Capital One's Guide to Benefits.

benefits.name: Purchase Security
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases against accidental damage or theft, up to $1,000 per loss and $25,000 per account per 12-month period.
benefits.terms: Purchase must be made with the card.

benefits.name: Price Protection
benefits.description: Reimburses the price difference if an item's price drops within 120 days of purchase, up to $250 per claim, up to 4 claims per 12-month period.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation/Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $1,500 when a trip booked with the card is canceled or cut short due to a covered reason.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 per day for 3 days for essential purchases when checked baggage is delayed 4+ hours on a trip booked with the card.

benefits.name: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Automatic accidental death/dismemberment coverage on common carrier trips when the full fare is charged to the card.
benefits.terms: Covers cardholder and eligible family members.

benefits.name: 24/7 Concierge Service
benefits.description: Complimentary concierge assistance for reservations, event tickets, and travel planning, available 24/7.

earningRates.terms: Hotels, vacation rentals, and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel.
